findings: Overview shows fourteen recessed joints in the existing central case, with separate retained nut/pin hardware.
Cover-hidden view exposes orange upper/lower seals around the existing bevel drive; surrounding transmission units are omitted for this inspection.
Joint-pattern view confirms seven fasteners per seal and two separated, symmetric sealing sheets around the shaft openings.
Clipped upper joint view exposes gasket stock and both seated fastener ends; this is an inspection crop, not changed native geometry.
SNL23 overlay retains the existing bearing-based scale and shaft origin. The split lies in the expected region; the upper fastening station is lower than depicted and the rear contour is flatter.
Source does not resolve the full transverse bolt pattern or the precise flange/recess forms. HB121 joint marks differ from SNL MX8 and remain an applicability uncertainty.
